author: Julia McCoy
description:
👉 *TRY Abacus AI* – https://studio.abacus.ai/fmj

*One paragraph typed into a chat box, and AI came back with a playable 5v5 MOBA: five original champions, three lanes, turrets, a shop, and bots that fight back. Then it built two more games.*

Apps and websites are a closed chapter. A 3D game is thousands of *taste calls* that used to need an art team and months, and this tool makes them itself, opens *Blender*, and grades its own screenshots against its concept art.

What you'll learn:
✅ The *pictures-before-code* loop all three builds run on
✅ A cinematic camera reveal written in code from one sentence
✅ What each game *admitted* it didn't finish, and why that matters

One line in the MOBA build made me trust this more than the map did.

#AI #GameDev #AITools

First Movers is Julia's AI company focused on helping working professionals and founders create massive efficiency in their businesses and workplaces.
